content: व्यञ्जक {%a.%} (-ञ्जिका|{%f.%}) .²1 Making clear, indicating, showing, manifesting. .²2 Suggesting or insinuating a meaning (as a word, <ab>opp.</ab> वाचक and लाक्षणिक <ab>qq. vv.</ab>). .{@-कः@} .²1 Dramatic action or gesture, external indication of an internal feeling by suitable gesticulation. .²2 A sign, symbol. .²3 Figurative expression or insinuation.
